title: Semantic Plan to Authoritative Placement
summary: Generalized Compute Intentions fronts the routing/allocation stack with a non-mutating planned-admittance route; WLU and Job-to-Node remain the authorities that make admission and placement real.
why: This gives Workbench, customer-service style intention callers, LLM workloads and ordinary compute one semantic interface without moving authority into the convenience layer.
invariants: A plan is evidence, not entitlement.
Generalized Compute Intentions dynamically rediscovers candidate resources and preserves native workload/resource objects.
Before mutation, compute capability, router policy, WLU admission and allocator placement evidence are revalidated.
CPU, GPU, ZeroGPU and LLM endpoints are resource classes under the same semantic planning boundary.
